notes: ChadGotchi (CHAD) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 (OpenZeppelin v5.4.0 ERC20, solc 0.8.26) in src/ChadGotchi.sol. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 CHAD (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, 18 decimals) once to msg.sender, which on this launch is the ProjectFactory; the factory then forwards the swarm share to the launch's MerkleDistributor, seeds the IMD pool single-sided with 80% of the supply and sends the rest to economics.remainderTo. The token has no owner, minter, pauser, blocklist, tax, burn-on-transfer, reflection, hook, fallback or receive, and no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT in its runtime; totalSupply can never grow after deployment and nobody but a holder (or a spender the holder approved) can move a holder's balance. Every transfer delivers exactly the amount asked for, so the distributor transfer, claims, the pool seed and swaps through the PoolManager all move exactly what they say. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. pool.initialPrice is provenance only: the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (3,500 IMD for the whole supply) and token.totalSupply.
